response.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_matched_scans FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.riskeval ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Share is the group's scan count divided by the total number of scans that match a site (inner join), computed as a real number without rounding.
Ties in share are broken arbitrarily since the request gives no tie-break rule.
